modelObjects.name: Coldaine K8s Platform
modelObjects.caption: Homelab K8s platform
modelObjects.description: A single declaratively-managed Kubernetes homelab cluster on Proxmox VE 9 + Talos Linux. Git is the plan; apply is deliberate (no GitOps selfHeal). Four layers bottom-up: host, node OS, platform, apps. Rebuild of a previous cluster that failed on execution, not vision.

modelObjects.name: Operator
modelObjects.caption: Solo operator (Patrick)
modelObjects.description: Patrick, the solo human operator. Commits desired state to git and runs the deliberate apply (tofu / talhelper / helmfile / kubectl). No live edits; drift is made visible and corrected on purpose. Agents may also mutate the cluster through the scoped Kubernetes MCP server (ADR 0017).

modelObjects.name: Git (GitHub)
modelObjects.caption: GitHub repo (external)
modelObjects.description: External GitHub repo holding desired state and docs (coldaine-k8cluster-redoALL). Git is the plan and the record, not a controller - no continuous reconciliation / selfHeal (ADR 0002). State changes only through git, then apply.

modelObjects.name: Doppler
modelObjects.caption: Canonical secret store (external)
modelObjects.description: External canonical secret store. Holds app config, DB role passwords, backup S3 keys, and build/push tokens. Git holds only ExternalSecret / ClusterSecretStore references - never values. SOPS + offline vault cover cluster-recovery material that must survive cluster death (ADR 0013).

modelObjects.name: Host Substrate
modelObjects.caption: Layer 1 - host
modelObjects.description: Host substrate layer (ADR 0001). Proxmox VE 9 hypervisor on SER8 + EVO-X2 hardware on VLAN 30 / 192.168.30.0/24, plus the EVO-X2 Qwen LXC sidecar and the HAOS VM. Declared in tofu/, applied with tofu apply (ADR 0006).

modelObjects.name: Node OS
modelObjects.caption: Layer 2 - node OS
modelObjects.description: Node OS layer. Talos Linux VMs - immutable, API-managed, no hand-built node. Declared in talos/ via talhelper + SOPS, applied with talhelper genconfig + apply (ADR 0001, 0006).

modelObjects.name: Platform
modelObjects.caption: Layer 3 - platform
modelObjects.description: Platform layer - operators, CNI, TLS, storage, ingress, builds, observability. Declared in platform/helmfile.yaml, applied with helmfile apply (ADR 0006). One apply path; every component defaults to its upstream maintained Helm chart, pinned by version.

modelObjects.name: Apps
modelObjects.caption: Layer 4 - apps
modelObjects.description: Apps layer - runtime workloads. Declared in apps/ as manifests, applied with kubectl apply (ADR 0011). Copy apps/_template/ to add an app; three workload shapes (web/API, worker, scheduled batch).

modelObjects.name: OpenTofu
modelObjects.caption: tofu apply
modelObjects.description: OpenTofu + bpg/proxmox provider (v0.111.0). Provisions every Proxmox VM and the Qwen LXC from git - no hand qm (ADR 0006). Retrofit, do not rebuild: the live Phase 0 node is imported, not recreated.

modelObjects.name: Proxmox VE 9
modelObjects.caption: Hypervisor
modelObjects.description: Proxmox VE 9 hypervisor substrate (pve-no-subscription repo; enterprise repos disabled). Two nodes on VLAN 30 / 192.168.30.0/24 (KubernetesCluster in UniFi). Owns the host boundary; not the Kubernetes node config.

modelObjects.name: pve-ser8
modelObjects.caption: SER8 host
modelObjects.description: Proxmox host on SER8-class hardware, mgmt 192.168.30.2. Runs the talos-cp-01 control-plane VM (VMID 110).

modelObjects.name: pve-evo-x2
modelObjects.caption: EVO-X2 host (Strix Halo)
modelObjects.description: Proxmox host on EVO-X2 (Strix Halo, 64GB), mgmt 192.168.30.6. Runs the EVO Talos worker (VMID 112) and the Qwen 3.6 inference LXC (CTID 1201).

modelObjects.name: Home Assistant OS VM
modelObjects.caption: haos-01 (Proxmox VM)
modelObjects.description: Home Assistant OS VM (haos-01, VMID 111) on Proxmox - not a Kubernetes pod (ADR 0004). USB Zigbee radio passthrough for Third Reality soil sensors; soil-collector reads sensor state via its REST API. Static 192.168.30.12 not yet set (currently live at DHCP .103, R-102).

modelObjects.name: Qwen 3.6 LXC Sidecar
modelObjects.caption: llm-qwen36 (Proxmox LXC)
modelObjects.description: EVO-X2 Qwen 3.6 inference sidecar (llm-qwen36, CTID 1201). Privileged Proxmox LXC running source-built llama.cpp on Mesa RADV / Vulkan. Serves qwen36-35b-a3b-mtp at 262,144 context on 192.168.30.31:8080. Host substrate, NOT a Kubernetes app - proves Vulkan serving before any K8s GPU work (ADR 0014).

modelObjects.name: talhelper
modelObjects.caption: talhelper + SOPS
modelObjects.description: talhelper (v3.1.12) + SOPS. Source of truth is talconfig.yaml + SOPS-encrypted talsecret.sops.yaml; genconfig renders per-node machine configs into gitignored clusterconfig/. Puts Talos node config under version control with secrets encrypted in git (ADR 0006).

modelObjects.name: Talos Linux
modelObjects.caption: Immutable node OS
modelObjects.description: Talos Linux - immutable, API-managed Kubernetes node OS. kube-proxy-free; Cilium provides CNI. Permanent static addresses from first boot; native Kubernetes API VIP (no kube-vip).

modelObjects.name: talos-cp-01 (Control Plane)
modelObjects.caption: Control-plane VM
modelObjects.description: Phase 0 control-plane VM talos-cp-01 (VMID 110) on pve-ser8, 192.168.30.11. Single schedulable control plane for now; HA control plane is reserved but out of scope until multi-node is real.

modelObjects.name: talos-worker-evo-x2 (Worker)
modelObjects.caption: Worker VM (NotReady)
modelObjects.description: Worker VM talos-worker-evo-x2 (VMID 112) on pve-evo-x2, 192.168.30.21. NotReady as of 2026-06-30 (reckoning R-101) - the VM exists but is not scheduling. Coexistence with the Qwen LXC is decided from measured VRAM/GTT/RAM pressure after the sidecar baseline.

modelObjects.name: Helmfile
modelObjects.caption: helmfile apply
modelObjects.description: platform/helmfile.yaml - the one declarative apply path for the platform (ADR 0006). Pinned maintained Helm charts in waves A/B/C/D; helmfile diff is always safe, apply is gated between waves. The default install path for any new platform component is its upstream maintained Helm chart.

modelObjects.name: Cilium
modelObjects.caption: CNI + Gateway API
modelObjects.description: Cilium (1.19.5) - CNI + Gateway API + L2 Announcements + LB-IPAM. kube-proxy-free with KubePrism 127.0.0.1:7445. No ingress-nginx (retired/EOL), no MetalLB. Hubble enabled for eBPF network observability (ADR 0007, 0015).

modelObjects.name: cert-manager
modelObjects.caption: TLS issuer
modelObjects.description: cert-manager (v1.20.3). Issues TLS certificates for Cilium Gateway listeners; per-app routing is HTTPRoute objects in apps/. main-tls not yet issued (R-601/R-602) - blocks public routes.

modelObjects.name: Longhorn
modelObjects.caption: Block storage
modelObjects.description: Longhorn distributed block storage (1.12.0, V2 GA). Always-on storage for PVCs, database volumes, and observability dashboards/logs. snapshot-controller (piraeus) provides VolumeSnapshot CRDs required by KubeBlocks DataProtection.

modelObjects.name: CloudNativePG
modelObjects.caption: Postgres operator (bridge)
modelObjects.description: CloudNativePG operator (0.28.3, app 1.29.1). Runs Postgres - explicitly a bridge for PG19 (KubeBlocks tops out at PG18). KubeBlocks remains the strategic multi-engine operator and the consolidation target once it gains PG19 support (ADR 0010, amends ADR 0002).

modelObjects.name: KubeBlocks
modelObjects.caption: Multi-engine DB operator
modelObjects.description: KubeBlocks operator (1.0.2). Strategic multi-engine operator - runs FalkorDB (graph) and future engines. Postgres lives on CloudNativePG only until KubeBlocks gains solid PG19 support, then Postgres migrates back and CNPG is retired (ADR 0010).

modelObjects.name: External Secrets Operator
modelObjects.caption: ESO bridge to Doppler
modelObjects.description: External Secrets Operator (2.7.0). Provider-neutral Kubernetes bridge to Doppler - materializes runtime Secret mirrors from ExternalSecret / ClusterSecretStore. Chosen over the Doppler Kubernetes Operator to keep one CRD model and preserve backend portability (ADR 0013). 20 ExternalSecrets across 6 namespaces, all SecretSynced.

modelObjects.name: Shipwright + Tekton
modelObjects.caption: In-cluster image builds
modelObjects.description: Shipwright + Tekton (wave C pinned release manifests). In-cluster image builds via BuildKit. Privileged fallback active on Talos because rootless BuildKit hit snapshot bind-mount permission failures. Workloads pin images by digest only after a build succeeds (ADR 0005). Kaniko and hand-rolled build Jobs rejected.

modelObjects.name: cloudflared
modelObjects.caption: Outbound tunnel
modelObjects.description: cloudflared outbound tunnel (wave C). Dials out to Cloudflare and routes public traffic to the in-cluster Cilium Gateway. No inbound WAN ports; databases are never published through the Gateway.

modelObjects.name: Kubernetes MCP Server
modelObjects.caption: Agent surface (ADR 0017)
modelObjects.description: Project-scoped Kubernetes MCP server - the agent interface to the cluster (ADR 0017). Full-write (not read-only) via a scoped mcp-agent ServiceAccount in cluster-meta; write confined to cluster-meta ConfigMaps initially. Amends ADR 0002/0006 no-hand-apply rule for the agent surface. A periodic diagnostic agent writes a ranked cluster-status report into the cluster-status ConfigMap.

modelObjects.name: Observability Stack
modelObjects.caption: LGTM-lite (wave D)
modelObjects.description: Observability stack (wave D, ADR 0015) - LGTM-lite. kube-prometheus-stack + Loki + Grafana Alloy + prometheus-pve-exporter, on Longhorn. Cilium Hubble provides eBPF network visibility for free. Traces (Tempo), profiling (Pyroscope), and AI RCA deferred.

modelObjects.name: kube-prometheus-stack
modelObjects.caption: Metrics anchor
modelObjects.description: kube-prometheus-stack (69.8.2) - Prometheus Operator, Alertmanager, Grafana, kube-state-metrics, node_exporter. ServiceMonitor / PodMonitor CRDs give CNPG, KubeBlocks, and Talos dashboards out of the box.

modelObjects.name: Loki + Alloy
modelObjects.caption: Logs anchor
modelObjects.description: Loki (6.30.1) for log aggregation + Grafana Alloy (1.1.2) as the OpenTelemetry-compatible collector/router. Explicitly avoids the deprecated/EOL Promtail and Grafana Agent.

modelObjects.name: prometheus-pve-exporter
modelObjects.caption: Proxmox metrics
modelObjects.description: prometheus-pve-exporter (2.8.0). Scrapes the Proxmox VE API to map observability end-to-end: Proxmox host -> Talos VM -> Pod.

modelObjects.name: Longhorn PVCs
modelObjects.caption: Block volumes
modelObjects.description: Persistent volumes provisioned by Longhorn (storageClass longhorn). Holds database volumes, observability dashboards/logs, and app state PVCs (soil-state 512Mi, frigate media 100Gi + config).

modelObjects.name: CNPG Postgres (pg18/pg19)
modelObjects.caption: Relational DBs
modelObjects.description: Postgres on CloudNativePG. pg18 (all-extensions custom image, Shipwright-built per ADR 0009) holds every live logical DB: llm_archiver, techdeals_work, market_raw, market_live, moosegoose, soil, hangar - many databases in one cluster via CNPG Database CRs. pg18 is NotReady with broken backups 2026-06-30 (R-301/R-302): the pinned image digest 61cd0525 predates barman-cli-cloud, so CNPG backups/WAL archive are failing. pg19 is declared in git, not applied (future, beta).

modelObjects.name: FalkorDB
modelObjects.caption: Graph DB (declared)
modelObjects.description: FalkorDB graph database on a KubeBlocks addon. Declared in git, NOT applied live (R-305) - the falkordb-auth ExternalSecret is synced but the Cluster CR is not applied. Stays on KubeBlocks when Postgres eventually migrates back (ADR 0010).

modelObjects.name: Garage S3
modelObjects.caption: In-cluster S3
modelObjects.description: In-cluster Garage single-node S3 (v2.3.0, ADR 0012 - supersedes archived MinIO/ADR 0008). Serves DB backups (CNPG barman + KubeBlocks DataProtection) and general app object storage at http://garage.backups.svc:3900 (path-style). Manifest exception under ADR 0006 item 3a - no maintained versioned Helm chart exists. No S3 Object Lock; Cloudflare R2 offsite tier deferred.

modelObjects.name: kubectl
modelObjects.caption: kubectl apply
modelObjects.description: kubectl apply - the apps-layer delivery tool (ADR 0011). Applies apps/ manifests deliberately; no selfHeal. Agents use the scoped MCP server instead of ad-hoc kubectl at a terminal (ADR 0017).

modelObjects.name: soil-web
modelObjects.caption: Soil dashboard (live, drifted)
modelObjects.description: Garden soil-moisture dashboard (soil.moosegoose.xyz, port 8787). Reads the pg18 soil logical DB + weather/lightning PVC. Live but drifted 2026-06-30: RollingUpdate vs git Recreate (Multi-Attach RWO PVC), image :latest vs git digest, 0/1 Available (R-401/402/403). soil-collector CronJob reads Third Reality Zigbee sensors via the HA REST API; weather/lightning CronJobs declared but not live.

modelObjects.name: home-app
modelObjects.caption: Home app (declared)
modelObjects.description: Internal home application. Scaffolded stateless; durable DB wiring is an open data-owner call. Declared in git, NOT deployed (R-404) - no Deployment/Service/HTTPRoute/Build live; image digest is a REPLACE_WITH_DIGEST placeholder.

modelObjects.name: moosegoose-web
modelObjects.caption: Public website (declared)
modelObjects.description: Public website (moosegoose.xyz), 2 replicas, port 3000. DB via pg18-rw.data-platform.svc.cluster.local. Declared in git, NOT deployed (R-404) - image digest is a REPLACE_WITH_DIGEST placeholder.

modelObjects.name: frigate
modelObjects.caption: NVR (declared)
modelObjects.description: NVR for IP/RTSP cameras (ADR 0004). In-cluster, pinned to the EVO-X2 worker for iGPU/Coral + storage; 100Gi media PVC. Declared in git, NOT deployed (R-406). Internal-only route - deliberately not exposed via cloudflared (do not make the NVR public).
